summary: Frontend testing of 6 new features: Profile Calculator, Progress Dashboard, Share Modal, Notification System, Water Practices TTS, and Main Menu updates. All public features verified working correctly. Protected routes (Settings, Progress Dashboard) require authentication as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: ProfileCalculator.jsx: Full Gene Keys and Human Design calculations implemented. Birth data form with date/time/place inputs. Gene Keys shows Life's Work, Evolution, Radiance, Purpose with Shadow/Gift/Siddhi. Human Design shows type, strategy, signature, not-self, profile lines. Share button integrated.
ShareModal.jsx: Complete social sharing with Twitter/X, Facebook, WhatsApp, Email buttons. Copy link functionality. Native share API support for mobile devices.
NotificationSystem.jsx: Full notification provider with moon phase alerts, daily wisdom, practice reminders. Browser push notification support. In-app notification center with read/unread states.
Settings.jsx: Sacred Notifications section with toggles for Moon Phase Alerts, Daily Wisdom, Practice Reminders, Browser Notifications. Notification time picker and test notification button.
WaterPractices.jsx: Play Guided Audio button in practice detail modal. TTS integration for generating guided meditation audio from practice steps.
ProgressDashboard.jsx: Visual tracking with weekly chart, element balance, practice breakdown, achievements, milestones. Uses mock data for demo when API fails.
MainMenu.jsx: Profile Calculator correctly placed under Divination & Guidance. Progress Dashboard correctly placed under Sacred Tools.
test_credentials: No login required for public pages. Settings and Progress Dashboard require authentication.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 new features verified: (1) Profile Calculator at /profile-calculator: Birth data form with date/time/place inputs, Calculate button triggers Gene Keys and Human Design calculations, Gene Keys tab shows Activation Sequence with Life's Work/Evolution/Radiance/Purpose spheres each with Shadow/Gift/Siddhi, Human Design tab shows type (Generator/Manifesting Generator/Projector/Manifestor/Reflector) with Strategy/Signature/Not-Self/Profile. (2) Share Modal: Opens from share button, shows Twitter/X, Facebook, WhatsApp, Email buttons plus copy link. (3) Notification System: Settings page has Sacred Notifications section with Moon Phase Alerts, Daily Wisdom, Practice Reminders, Browser Notifications toggles. (4) Water Practices TTS: Practice detail modal has 'Play Guided Audio' button for TTS-generated guided meditation. (5) Progress Dashboard at /progress: Protected route requiring login, shows mock data for demo. (6) Main Menu: Profile Calculator under Divination & Guidance, Progress Dashboard under Sacred Tools.
